Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the Lady Washington as the official ship of the state of Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the Lady Washington as the officialship of the state of Washington; and adding a new section to chapter1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Lady Washington is hereby designated as the official ship ofthe state of Washington.
